title: Unify Organica Hair Oil
how: Massage a small amount into the scalp and through the lengths. Leave on for at least 1 hour or overnight, then wash with Unify Organica Hair Shampoo. Use 2–3 times a week.

title: Unify Organica Hair Shampoo
how: Apply to wet hair, massage into the scalp to a lather and rinse well. Gentle enough for daily use.

title: Unify Organica Joints Oil
how: Warm a few drops between your palms and massage gently into knees and joints in circular motions for 3–5 minutes, twice a day. For external use only. Do not apply to broken skin.

title: Unify Organica Body Wash
how: Squeeze onto a loofah or wet hands, lather over the body and rinse off.

title: Unify Organica Hand Wash
how: Pump onto wet hands, rub together for 20 seconds and rinse.
